messages.subject: Job offer at Intel, ML student.
parts:
Hi everyone,
We are looking for M.Sc or PhD candidates working in the field of ML for a part time job at Intel.
We are a part of the new devices group, in charge of developing new wearable devices and next generation solutions for Intel.
Our tasks involve personalization, user understanding, user clustering etc. and touch many interesting aspects of machine learning.

Job location- Yakum (15 minutes from Tel Aviv)

For more info, please send me an email:
omri.mendels at intel.com

I'll send a link to the job description soon.
